fact: La Gazette des Comores reports that the Registre social unique continues to be set up in Comoros, with 62,000 households registered, per the World Bank representative.
The PFSS-RRC says the extension aims to improve crisis response through the operationalisation of the Registre Social Unique.
PFSS-RRC states the Registre social unique holds 81,075 households, with operations in 152 of 319 localities, used as a targeting instrument for public aid.
The Msaanda phase rests on making the single social registry (RSU) operational to identify and target households, according to the article.
